verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable gateway, but the evidence pack never documents a way to disable vendor telemetry or usage tracking. The cited material covers the customer's own observability tooling (usage analytics, OTLP metrics, audit logs) and a hybrid-mode note that the control plane stays out of the data path by default. Both are adjacent features, not a documented opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
